name: Le Triomphant (S616), Triomphant-class SSBN (SNLE-NG)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'Triomphant-class submarine' (raw wikitext read 2026-11-12, js/hero/fr_navy_late.js header): 138 x 12.5 m, draught 10.6 m

references.name: [T1] Triomphant class SSBN.svg, starboard silhouette
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Triomphant class SSBN.svg' (en.wikipedia), rendered 1600 px
references.note: Shroud x 0 to bow x 1597 = the published 138 m (11.57 px/m); keel row 254, the waterline the published 10.6 m draught above it: X = px / 11.57 - 69.0, Z = (254 - py) / 11.57 - 10.6. Column scan of the alpha: the hump's top row 91 (3.49) px 500..1060; the sail's after edge px 1060..1075, top row 3 (11.09), front px 1222..1228, the fillet to px 1260; the bow fairing px 1418..1431; the cruciform px 106..150 (upper to row 85, lower to 246, axis row 177); the shroud px 4..68 (rows 138..216). Ignored: the masts and periscopes the model has raised over the sail (the silhouette has them housed).

references.name: [T2] Le Temeraire surfaced, from astern and above
references.note: For the reviewer: the sister boat from astern: the large sail planes high on the sail (about 2.2 m under its top), the flat casing on the round hull, the upper rudder, the matt black tiled finish.

references.name: [T3] SNLE / SNLE-NG missile-compartment sections side by side
references.note: A schematic section (left Le Redoutable, right Le Triomphant): each tube under a hatch in the casing's flat top. Ratios to the Triomphant hull's radius (525 px): the tube's centre 165 px off the centreline (0.31 -> y 1.9 m), the hatch and coaming about 300 px across (0.58 -> 3.6 m), the casing top flat to about 240 px (0.46 -> 2.9 m) before its shoulder. Not to scale vertically.

references.name: [T4] a Triomphant-class boat surfaced, from ahead
references.note: Scaled on the sail's height over the casing (7.6 m = 143 px, 18.8 px/m at the sail): the sail 67 px = 3.6 m wide, the sail planes 230 px = 12.2 m tip to tip at 103 px = 5.5 m over the casing (z 9.0), level; the masts raised, the casing smooth and black.

references.name: [T5] Le Terrible (S619), port broadside at a distance
references.note: Bow left; 8.1 - 8.5 px/m off the sail's 14.4 m: the sail's upright front and raked back, four masts raised, the long low smooth casing (no hatch coamings in its line); the sail plane edge-on 2.0 - 2.5 m under the sail's top, from 0.75 m to 4.3 m abaft its front (root X 36.1 .. 32.6).

must_show: a long round hull 137.9 m (shroud X -68.65 to bow X +69.0), 12.5 m beam, the missile-section hump's flat top 3.49 m from X -26 to the sail, falling to 2.1 m at X 52, keel -10.6

the casing on the hull's back from the knuckle (z 0.3, X -27 .. 48) to a broad rounded top: [T3] traced falls 0.08 / 0.19 / 0.31 / 0.46 m below the crown at y 2.86 / 3.21 / 3.45 / 3.69 (flat within 0.1 m to about y 3.0, 6.0 m); the model's section is flat to y 3.24 and rounds down 0.45 m by y 3.69 (within 0.26 m of the trace), sloped sides below
